name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: A multi-line text input on Base UI's Input rendering a <textarea>, in Input's three sizes, with placeholder, invalid and disabled states; works inside a Field.

manifest.name: textarea
manifest.title: Textarea
manifest.description: A multi-line text input on Base UI's Input rendering a <textarea>, in Input's three sizes, with placeholder, invalid and disabled states; works inside a Field.
manifest.usage: Use Textarea for text that may span lines (descriptions, notes, filters, short SQL); use Input for one line and the SQL editor for real queries. Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel; set rows to the expected length (3 by default). It resizes vertically; pass className="resize-none" to stop that.

props.name: size
props.description: Padding matched to Input's sizes, from the density-aware space roles; the height follows rows.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value on every change.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignores interaction, stops resizing and sets data-disabled.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Marks the value invalid outside a Field; inside a Field, data-invalid comes from its validation.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The textarea; data-slot="textarea" and data-size name it.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Focused: a ring of ring.width in color.ring, offset by ring.offset.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Invalid value: the danger border. Inside a Field the same style follows data-invalid.

states.name: invalid-in-field
states.description: Invalid inside a Field (its validation or its invalid prop sets data-invalid).

states.name: disabled
states.description: Ignores interaction and resizing, at opacity.disabled.

accessibility: Renders a native <textarea>; give it a FieldLabel (or a <label>), or aria-label when there is no room for one.
Enter inserts a line break and Tab leaves the field, as in any textarea; do not trap Tab.
Placeholder text is a hint, not a label; it uses color.fg.subtle, contrast-checked on every surface.
Mark errors with a Field (aria-invalid and aria-describedby follow) or aria-invalid; the danger border is not the only signal.
The border (color.border.strong) meets 3:1 against every surface; focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring.
